title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30431: expose report sender and globals
summary: Report 952's time sheet processing events now expose the report sender and global variables to subscribers, enabling report customization through event handlers.
key_points: Extensions can now access report instance and globals when subscribing to time sheet events
Supports time sheet report customization scenarios
quote: Extensions need access to report 952 and its protected global variables when subscribing to the two time sheet processing events.
